Good day. This is Sultana Al-Qahtani with the Sahel Desk.

Bottom line: no new or materially updated fused candidate event has appeared since the previous briefing. This collection cycle did retain 1 new relevant report, so the desk is reporting those as fresh context rather than repeating stale event language.

Fresh report 1: Africa Defense Forum (ADF Magazine) reports from Mali: JNIM Expansion Across Malian Border Threatens Guinea. This is retained reporting context and is not automatically treated as a new incident.

Quantitative picture: seven-day fused-event counts are unchanged from the previous briefing.

Analytic note: reporting volume, fused candidate events, and independently verified incidents are different measures. Source claims and unresolved contradictions remain attributed to their underlying reporting.

Collection status: 0 of 74 configured sources failed during the latest cycle and 13 were degraded. The retained archive contains 135 French or Arabic reports; 135 have an English title translation and 0 remain marked failed for retry.

Nothing further to report at this time.
